name: Starlings
description: A murmuration over an estuary at sunset: thousands of starlings make one shape that swells, folds and pours across the sky, six bodies of birds each swelling with its own part of the spectrum; folds move with the middle notes, dark waves sweep through the flock faster on the beat, stragglers scatter with the high notes. The channels hold the sky and the flock, a ruined pier stands on its stilts and the reeds in front sway with the bass.
